_comment: User, 2026-11-07: AIC-quality pilot for d_f, d = 4. The pooled data (29 + 08, 4..128) fit one range only, 6 points, so AIC had nothing to choose. Same box cap (128, int32 labels), rungs round(4 * sqrt(2)^k): 11 points. Not geometric, so pilot.py draws no pilot_fit.png; tools/local_slope.omega_ranges takes any increasing scales. n = 20 x 29's pilot rule 558 * (128 / i)^2: with cv ~ 0.8 at 128, 5 replicates give se(log Ybar) ~ 0.0034 there, the pooled data's 0.0028. 29's pilot took 44 s per replicate at 1x on niagara.
